name: Amazon Music
summary:
Amazon Music is the streaming product at music.amazon.com. The icon is not assumed to be the Amazon shopping favicon from www.amazon.com.

Checked 12 November 2026 against music.amazon.com. HTML came from https://music.amazon.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://m.media-amazon.com/images/G/01/music/logo/1.0/smile_256x256.png; shortcut icon → https://m.media-amazon.com/images/G/01/music/logo/1.0/smile_256x256.png; apple-touch-icon → https://m.media-amazon.com/images/G/01/music/logo/1.0/smile_256x256.png.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. music.amazon.com did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://m.media-amazon.com/images/G/01/music/logo/1.0/smile_256x256.png, measured at 256×256 png.

Brand colour #0f1111 comes from the theme-color meta tag.

Largest measured bitmap: png-256x256-01.png at 256×256 (png, 27669 bytes) from https://m.media-amazon.com/images/G/01/music/logo/1.0/smile_256x256.png.
